name: X-Man Galaxy Megaminx V2
description: The X-Man Galaxy Megaminx V2 is the upgraded version of the highly-acclaimed X-Man Galaxy Megaminx, which was used to set numerous records. Compared to the V1, the V2 features a more compact design, lower weight, improved corner cutting, and an overall more stable feel. The stickerless variant also comes with a set of black parts in the box, which can be used to switch one side to black.
